notes:
Inbound SMB lead. Signed up self-serve last week using free credits. Primary product interest: hosted_api (early PoC). Main workload: a support assistant that streams partial answers and calls internal tools for account lookups (tool-calling + structured JSON output). Customer reports intermittent failures when using JSON-mode + function-calls in streaming: sometimes receives partial stream with invalid JSON (trailing commas / missing closing brace), sometimes the function call payload arrives as a string instead of parsed object. They are on a Node.js front-end -> server relay model; experimenting with browser streaming which hit CORS/connection-reset several times.

Customer quote: "Streaming works 85% of the time but when it fails it breaks our downstream parsers — we need deterministic JSON from function calls."

Initial contact (2026-02-22): quick discovery call with Omar (AE) and Priya (SE). They demoed a failing flow and shared a short repro bundle on Drive. Customer prefers quick wins: sample SDK snippet + config to force well-formed function payloads, and recommended backoff/retry handling for streaming chunks.

Security: SOC2 is required; they expect SSO/SAML for production. No sensitive PII in current PoC data but they will add customer emails later. Public cloud only for PoC; may consider Private later if ARR grows.

Pricing sensitivity: high — SMB. Looking for low per-token cost and stable latency. ARR estimate low but potential to expand into paid tier if product stable.

AE notes: customer is technical, full-stack engs on the call. Fast mover if we can provide clear reproduction steps and small code patch. Recommended to reproduce using server-side Node relay (to avoid browser preflight issues) and to instrument token-by-token stream joiner.

Action items: SE to deliver patched SDK snippet that forces function-call outputs to be emitted as single JSON object at end-of-stream or as discrete function events (if using streaming events pattern). Devs to try disabling chunked-transfer on the relay to see if that reduces partial payloads.
